title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose your university is seeking students’ opinions on whether university sports facilities should be open to the public. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: In my view, university sports facilities should be opened to the public rather than kept behind closed gates. In the following paragraphs I will give my reasons. To begin with, these facilities are usually built with public funding, yet they stand empty on weekends and holidays. Opening them turns a wasted resource into a shared benefit for taxpayers. What is more, many communities lack affordable places to exercise, so free access to a campus track or gym would clearly improve residents' health. Admittedly, some people worry about campus safety and extra costs. Nevertheless, these problems can be eased by fixed opening hours, an entry registration and a small fee. To sum up, I firmly believe that universities should open their sports facilities to the public. It is advisable that they first set up proper management, so that both students and residents can enjoy the resource in harmony.
keyPoints: 开门亮立场落地。首段用 In my view ... should be opened to the public rather than kept behind closed gates 一句直接选边，再用 In the following paragraphs I will give my reasons 预告下 文，正是『开门亮立场』方法的落地。
两理由＋让步成段。本段用 To begin with 给公共资源理由、What is more 给社区健康理 由，各配一句解释，再用 Admittedly ... Nevertheless ... 回应安全与成本顾虑，兑现了『分层给理由并 回应顾虑』。
重申加建议收束。结尾 To sum up, I firmly believe ... 重申立场与首段呼应，It is advisable that they first set up proper management 补一句建议收尾，完成『重申立场配建议』。
